brass_key.description: A tarnished brass key. Unlocks the R1-R2 door (Gallery to Archive).

stick.description: A sturdy wooden stick. Combine with a rock to craft a hammer.

rock.description: A fist-sized rock. Combine with a stick to craft a hammer.

hammer.description: A makeshift hammer. Breaks the barrier on the R3-R4 door (Workshop to Conservatory).

torch.description: An unlit torch. Combine with oil to craft a lit torch.

oil.description: A flask of lamp oil. Combine with a torch to craft a lit torch.

lit_torch.description: A blazing torch. Required to pass through the Exit door (R5-R7).

glyph_key.description: A mystical key whose id is decoded from a glyph image at the Archive terminal. Required for the R2-R6 door and the Exit door. The key carries an integer id that must equal (glyph_width // 8) % 16 for the scenario's glyph_index.

cursed_idol.description: An ominous idol. In the normal epoch, holding it blocks all move/teleport/exit actions; eclipse lifts the curse. It is a trap item — the canonical solution does not require it.

master_seal.description: A seal-breaker talisman. During the 'sealed' epoch phase, movement is blocked unless master_seal is in inventory.

eclipse_ward.description: A trap charm. During the 'eclipse' epoch phase (which normally lifts the curse), holding eclipse_ward re-imposes the movement block.

key_red.description: Red colour key. One of three colour keys; ALL three (key_red, key_green, key_blue) are required to use the exit and to win.

key_green.description: Green colour key. One of three colour keys required for the exit and the win condition.

key_blue.description: Blue colour key. One of three colour keys required for the exit and the win condition.
